cases.note: All four of §56.2’s conditions, the benchmark’s own seeds, and a black box segment behind it. The case that has to hold or every other one is measuring a function that refuses everything.

§56.1: a number nobody can attribute is not evidence. Every other field in this bundle is perfect and none of them is consulted — which is the point, because they are all claims the bundle makes about itself.
cases.expected: {"class":"unattested","rankable":false,"ranked_separately":false,"reasons":[{"blocks_field":true,"code":"device_signature","message":"The device's signature over this bundle is absent, so nothing in it is attributable to a machine. The result is recorded and is not ranked: a number nobody can attribute is not evidence, which is the whole of §56.1.","subjects":["absent"]}],"replayable":true}

cases.note: Nothing is wrong with the bytes; what is missing is a registered machine to attribute them to. A separate reason from an unsigned bundle because it is a separate thing to go and do.
cases.expected: {"class":"unattested","rankable":false,"ranked_separately":false,"reasons":[{"blocks_field":true,"code":"device_unknown","message":"The signature verifies and this Hub does not know the device that made it. Nothing is wrong with the bytes; what is missing is a registered machine to attribute them to. Register the device, then re-submit.","subjects":[]}],"replayable":true}

cases.note: §35.3 puts the obligation to declare on the driver and this is where it pays. Everything else about this run is field-grade, and it is still not a field result — a simulator on the field leaderboard is the single outcome the whole scheme exists to prevent.
cases.expected: {"class":"simulated","rankable":true,"ranked_separately":true,"reasons":[{"blocks_field":true,"code":"simulator_declared","message":"The RHAL driver declared itself a simulator (§35.3), so this is a simulated result and is ranked on the simulated table. This is the driver meeting its obligation rather than a fault — and a simulated run and a field run are not comparable numbers, which is why the tables are separate.","subjects":[]}],"replayable":true}

cases.note: The order that must not be rearranged for tidiness. The simulator flag is one of the bundle’s own claims, so a bundle nobody can attribute is `unattested` **before** the flag is read — and it is `unattested` rather than `simulated`, which is the stricter of the two.
cases.expected: {"class":"unattested","rankable":false,"ranked_separately":false,"reasons":[{"blocks_field":true,"code":"device_signature","message":"The device's signature over this bundle is failed, so nothing in it is attributable to a machine. The result is recorded and is not ranked: a number nobody can attribute is not evidence, which is the whole of §56.1.","subjects":["failed"]},{"blocks_field":true,"code":"simulator_declared","message":"The RHAL driver declared itself a simulator (§35.3), so this is a simulated result and is ranked on the simulated table. This is the driver meeting its obligation rather than a fault — and a simulated run and a field run are not comparable numbers, which is why the tables are separate.","subjects":[]}],"replayable":true}

cases.note: §50 read from §56’s side: without it, “a real robot of this model with these joint ratings” is a claim the machine makes about itself, and a leaderboard built on that is measuring a story. Recorded, not ranked as field.
cases.expected: {"class":"unattested","rankable":false,"ranked_separately":false,"reasons":[{"blocks_field":true,"code":"birth_unattested","message":"This robot's birth certificate does not attest it (§50), so \"a real robot of this model with these joint ratings\" is a claim the machine makes about itself. The result is recorded and not ranked as a field result.","subjects":[]}],"replayable":true}

cases.note: What produced these numbers is not established. The fourth of §56.2’s conditions, and the one a publisher is most likely to think does not matter.
cases.expected: {"class":"unattested","rankable":false,"ranked_separately":false,"reasons":[{"blocks_field":true,"code":"image_unattested","message":"The OS image running during this evaluation was not attested, so what produced these numbers is not established. Recorded, not ranked as a field result.","subjects":[]}],"replayable":true}

cases.note: §56.2 has three classes and not four. A bundle that meets three conditions has not established that it is a field result, and `unattested` is exactly what that means — a fourth class would be a leaderboard tier for nearly-evidence.
cases.expected: {"class":"unattested","rankable":false,"ranked_separately":false,"reasons":[{"blocks_field":true,"code":"birth_unattested","message":"This robot's birth certificate does not attest it (§50), so \"a real robot of this model with these joint ratings\" is a claim the machine makes about itself. The result is recorded and not ranked as a field result.","subjects":[]},{"blocks_field":true,"code":"image_unattested","message":"The OS image running during this evaluation was not attested, so what produced these numbers is not established. Recorded, not ranked as a field result.","subjects":[]}],"replayable":true}

cases.note: §56.3: seeds come from the benchmark and are never generated by the robot, because a robot that picks its own picks easy ones — and it need not do so dishonestly for the number to be worthless. This is not a run of that benchmark at all.
cases.expected: {"class":"unattested","rankable":false,"ranked_separately":false,"reasons":[{"blocks_field":true,"code":"seeds_not_supplied","message":"This run used seeds the benchmark did not supply (3 given, 3 used). §56.3: seeds come from the benchmark and are never generated by the robot, because a robot that picks its own seeds picks easy ones — and it need not do so dishonestly for the number to be worthless. This is not a run of that benchmark.","subjects":["3","3"]}],"replayable":true}

cases.note: Order as well as membership. Two runs over the same seeds in a different order are two different sequences of episodes, and a benchmark that fixes its seeds is fixing the sequence.
cases.expected: {"class":"unattested","rankable":false,"ranked_separately":false,"reasons":[{"blocks_field":true,"code":"seeds_not_supplied","message":"This run used seeds the benchmark did not supply (3 given, 3 used). §56.3: seeds come from the benchmark and are never generated by the robot, because a robot that picks its own seeds picks easy ones — and it need not do so dishonestly for the number to be worthless. This is not a run of that benchmark.","subjects":["3","3"]}],"replayable":true}

cases.note: Two benchmarks are two questions, and a score against one says nothing about the other. Caught here rather than by a reviewer, because §56.1’s whole point is that a reviewer reading a number cannot see any of this.
cases.expected: {"class":"unattested","rankable":false,"ranked_separately":false,"reasons":[{"blocks_field":true,"code":"benchmark_mismatch","message":"This bundle is a run of benchmark sha256:other and is being ranked against sha256:bench. Two benchmarks are two questions, and a score against one says nothing about the other.","subjects":["sha256:bench","sha256:other"]}],"replayable":true}

cases.note: §56.4 is the one observation that never changes the class: a result can be perfectly attested and have no recording behind it. Still `field`, and still reported — because a number with a replayable recording is a different class of claim from a number in a table.
cases.expected: {"class":"field","rankable":true,"ranked_separately":false,"reasons":[{"blocks_field":false,"code":"not_replayable","message":"No black box segment accompanies this run, so a disputed result cannot be replayed (§56.4). The class is unaffected — a result can be perfectly attested and unreplayable — but a number with a recording behind it is a different class of claim from a number in a table.","subjects":[]}],"replayable":false}
